# ADR-0030 — S1.5 contract clarifications (notify orchestration, shared job runner, `sync.stale` subject, event payload retention, settings-page composition, adapters over `fetchJson`, digest template, fixture-server POST)

## Status
Proposed

## Date
2026-09-03

## Slice
S1.5

## Context
Kind: deviation
- Spec says: `docs/build/04-server-contracts.md` §2.4 — `/api/cron/notify` runs "`notifyFanOut` then `notifyDeliver` (one run row)"; §3 — "each job: acquire lock → insert `sync_runs` → work → finalize row → revalidate → on failure emit `sync.failed` per J-F" and `docs/build/00-build-plan.md` §S1.5 — "`lib/notify/emit.ts` is wired into the **shared job runner**"; §3 J-S — dedupe on "the last `sync.stale` event for `subject_id = source`"; §4.5 — the Resend adapter goes "via `resend` SDK" while 05 T-ADP-17 says "SDK/`POST https://api.resend.com/emails`"; SC-09 — `fetchJson(url, {timeoutMs, retries, ua})`; §1.1 `deleteAccount` — comments → `deleted`, likes/reports removed, avatar removed, user deleted (nothing about `notification_events`); `docs/build/03-components.md` §2.10 `NotificationMatrix` props `{ matrix, comingLater, webhookMasked, adminEmails, allayImageUrl? }` and 02 §2.8 — "one form, SAVE SETTINGS → `updateSettings`" covering Moderation · Notifications · Moderators · Ko-fi; 03 E-01 — the template file list (`CommentNew`, `CommentHeld`, `CommentReported`, `SyncFailed`); 04 §4.6 — Discord 429 → "respect `retry_after` (ms) once"; ADR-0002 #73 — the e2e fixture server maps `GET /<source>/<path>`.
- Found: (1) no shared runner exists — S1.2's two jobs hand-roll lock/insert/finalize, so "inherits `sync.failed` through the runner" needs one; (2) `notification_events.subject_id` is `uuid not null` (migration `20260903090300`), so a `sync.stale` event cannot carry `subject_id = 'modrinth'`; (3) on production `youtube` has no `sync_runs` row until S1.6 ships `syncYoutube`, so the letter of J-S would mail "Sync stale: youtube" every 6 h for weeks; `mentions` has no table until S1.8; (4) the `resend` SDK hard-codes its base URL, so `RESEND_API_BASE` (ADR-0002 #73) and the H-5 fetch injection cannot reach it, and `fetchJson` is GET-only; (5) `notification_events.payload` keeps `{profile_id, handle}` references after `deleteAccount` (security-reviewer, S1.4 gate round 1) — retention undecided; (6) the moderation radios, the `comments_closed_default` switch and the Ko-fi field need client state to be saved by the same SAVE as the matrix, but the only client island 03 lists for the page is `NotificationMatrix`; (7) the N2 digest needs a body of its own; (8) T-E2E-37's Test button must reach the fixture server with a `POST`; (9) Discord's real 429 body carries `retry_after` in seconds.
- Related: ADR-0029 (schema wait, same PR) · ADR-0024 (page-scoped `'use server'` glue) · ADR-0028 (the S1.4 clarifications precedent) · `docs/questions.md` S1.4 gate follow-ups (d), supabase-reviewer follow-up (four FK indexes).

## Decision
1. **Shared job runner.** `lib/jobs/runner.ts` exports `runJob({ source, job, opts, work })`: SC-13 lock → SC-11 insert → `work(ctx)` → finalize on every path → **J-F edge emission**: when the run finished `ok=false` and the latest other **finalized** `sync_runs` row for the source (`ok IS NOT NULL`) has `ok = true` or none exists — an unfinalized older row (a run killed at `maxDuration` or crashed before finalize) is skipped, not read as a failed verdict, so an outage that begins with a crash still reaches the allay (01 INV-71; 05 T-ACT-74 crash cases, `tests/db/jobs/runner.test.ts`) — `emit('sync.failed', { subjectType: 'sync_run', subjectId: run_id, payload: { source, run_id, error(≤300), started_at } })`; a lock skip and the §3.2 `not_configured` run never emit; an `emit` failure is logged (`msg:'emit_failed'`) and never thrown. `syncModrinth` and `syncCurseforge` are moved onto it with their behaviour, summaries and tests unchanged; every later job uses it.
2. **`runNotify` orchestrates the cron pair.** `lib/jobs/notify.ts` `runNotify(opts)` owns the one `sync_runs` row (source `notify`) and the lock, then calls `notifyFanOut({ runId })` and `notifyDeliver({ runId })`; `items` = delivered count (02 §1.4). Called with a `runId`, the two jobs write no `sync_runs` row; called without one (tests, `triggerSync` never) each manages its own row. `/api/cron/notify` → `runNotify`.
3. **`sync.stale` subject and source set.** F0 emits `sync.stale` with `subject_type = 'sync_source'`, `subject_id = syncSourceSubjectId(source)` — a deterministic name-based UUID (v5 shape, `lib/notify/constants.ts`) — and payload `{ source, last_ok_at, hours_since_ok }`; dedupe = a `sync.stale` event for that subject inside 6 h. A source with **no `sync_runs` row at all is never stale** (nothing to be stale from — `youtube` on production until S1.6); the `curseforge` condition is `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY` set and ≥ 1 curseforge `project_links` row; the `mentions` condition is `false` until the `mentions` table lands (S1.8 wires it). 05 T-ACT-32's "`subject_id='modrinth'`" reads as this mapping.
4. **Event payload retention after `deleteAccount`.** Events are kept (admin audit; `actor_id` nulls through the FK) but `deleteAccount` scrubs the user before `auth.admin.deleteUser`: every top-level payload object whose `profile_id` equals the deleted id (`author`, `parent_author`, …) becomes `{ profile_id: null, handle: null }` (`lib/notify/emit.ts` `scrubProfileFromEvents(profileId)`, service client). Templates and embeds render a null handle as "a deleted account". 04 §1.1 `deleteAccount` Effects, SC-22 and data-model §2.6 gain the rule; 05 T-ACT-65 gains the assertion.
5. **Settings page composition.** `NotificationMatrix` is the page's ONE client island and owns the whole SAVE SETTINGS form: additive props (03 C-03) `moderationMode`, `commentsClosedDefault`, `kofiPage`, `kofiWebhookLive` and a `children` slot for the server-rendered Moderators `Table` (C-19 composition), so the order Moderation · Notifications · Moderators · Ko-fi · SAVE holds. Moderators row actions (Make mod / Remove / add by handle) are server `<form action>`s bound to page-scoped `'use server'` glue → `setUserRole` + PRG redirect with `?error=` (ADR-0024 pattern) — no second client file, no C-16a change. The webhook field: an untouched empty field means "unchanged" (omit), an explicit Remove control sends `''` (clear); the inline Test line reads `✔ Sent a test.` / `✕ Discord said no: <status>`.
6. **Adapters over `fetchJson`.** `lib/adapters/http.ts` `fetchJson` gains optional `method` and `body` (JSON, sets `Content-Type`) — GET stays the default, retries/timeouts unchanged. `lib/adapters/resend.ts` `sendEmail` is a plain `POST ${RESEND_API_BASE ?? 'https://api.resend.com'}/emails` with `Authorization: Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}` and the T-ADP-17 body; no `resend` npm dependency is added (INV-78 allows it, nothing needs it). `lib/adapters/discord.ts` `postEmbed` rewrites `https://discord.com/api` / `https://discordapp.com/api` to `DISCORD_API_BASE` when set (tests only) and posts `?wait=true`.
7. **Digest template.** `emails/templates/Digest.tsx` (`{ count, items: {kind, title, excerpt}[], url, manageUrl }`) joins E-01's list; one `EmailButton` ("Open admin"), subject "<N> things from the allay". The Discord digest is one embed of ≤ 25 lines built in `deliver/discord.ts`.
8. **Fixture server accepts POST** for two routes: `/discord/webhooks/<id>/<token>` → `tests/fixtures/discord/webhooks/<id>.json` (unknown id → 404, which the Test line shows as `✕ Discord said no: 404`) and `/resend/emails` → `tests/fixtures/resend/send-ok.json`; both `scripts/fixture-server.mjs` and `tests/helpers/fixtureServer.ts`. GET behaviour unchanged.
9. **Discord `retry_after`** is honoured as milliseconds per 04 §4.6 / T-ADP-18 (the fixture says `250`); Discord's live payload uses seconds — logged as a follow-up (`backend-robustness`, questions.md) rather than deviating from the frozen contract here.
10. **`notification_matrix` is seeded by its migration** (`insert … on conflict do nothing` — the ADR-0015 `site_settings` precedent, since production and `staging` never run `seed.sql`); `seed.sql` SEED-2 re-asserts the defaults with `on conflict do update`; `lib/notify/matrix.ts` `matrixDefaults` is the TypeScript twin and T-UNIT-27 checks all three agree.
11. **Housekeeping folded in** (S1.4 follow-ups): `check_handle(text)` and `can_comment(text, uuid)` get the every-role revoke + their intended grants re-stated (`20260903120200`), asserted in T-RLS-129 (`service_role` denied on `check_handle`); indexes on `comments.moderated_by`, `comment_reports.reporter_id`, `comment_reports.resolved_by`, `notification_events.actor_id` (`20260903120300`).
12. **`maskSecret` home.** `lib/format/secret.ts` (pure, client-importable — the Field placeholder and the tail in `updateSettings`'s return).
13. **Email `From`** = `odsens <${NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL}>` (04 N5); `Reply-To` is omitted until inbound forwarding for `allay@odsens.com` is confirmed (questions.md setup to-do) — recorded in the PR, not a rule change.
14. **Settings-action letter, as built** (build-pass findings, 2026-09-03): `kofi_page: ''` clears to NULL (the webhook rule); `discord_webhook_tail` is the raw last four characters (`secretTail`, `null` when unset) and `maskSecret` renders `…<tail>`; `testDiscordWebhook` resolves the URL (input, else stored) and answers `validation` with no rate-limit hit when there is none, then `assertRateLimit('discord_test')`, then posts — an HTTP failure reads "Discord said no: <status>", a transport failure "Discord didn't answer."; `setUserRole`'s last-admin `conflict` counts admins before and after the write and reverts (the concurrent-demotion window — with the actor an admin and the target ≠ self a one-admin state is otherwise unreachable, so 05 T-ACT-66 arranges it with `withDbHook`); `fetchJson` also gained `retryOn` (narrow-only) so the discord adapter's 429 follows §4.6's retry-once rule; the discord adapter refuses a URL outside the §1.3 regex (`unsupported`, no request) and the resend adapter refuses a blank `html`/`text` (`rejected`, no request). `setUserRole` refuses to give a banned account a staff role: target `is_banned = true` and `role ∈ {moderator, admin}` → `conflict` "Unban that account first." (no write, no audit line); `role = 'user'` always passes so the state is repairable. The mirror of 04 §1.2 `banUser`'s "demote first via `setUserRole`" — without it a promoted banned account keeps live moderator/admin action rights because `requireRole` reads the role only (SC-05 covers user/insert actions) while the proxy parks its browser on `/banned`. Raised by the S1.5 security lens in the build pass; the former "Refuse promoting a banned account" Alternatives row is closed by this rule.
15. **Email letter, as built:** `EmailBadge` stays Arial 11px (03 §2.11) — E-03's ≥ 13px floor applies to body/footer text; `emails/preview/*.tsx` default-export (react-email's preview requirement — a C-03 exception); `emails/components/shared.tsx` holds the hex mirror + template-internal helpers; templates take `siteUrl` and reference `wordmark@2x.png` at 84×20 attributes; the h1 is the target title and the event kind is the badge (the prototype's big kind word is carried by the badge); `comment.handle` is `string | null` (D4); `CommentHeld` takes `firstTime`, `SyncFailed` takes `hoursSinceOk` and `error: string | null`. `pnpm email dev` needs `@react-email/ui` (react-email's preview-server companion, dev only — the INV-78 "`react-email` dev" allowance covers it).
16. **Schema letter, as built:** `notification_recipients` carries no separate `(event_id)` index — the unique index `(event_id, channel, coalesce(address,''))` leads on it; `migration_versions()` is `language sql stable` (validated at creation against `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations`, which exists on every reset/hosted project); PostgREST returns enum columns in declaration order.
17. **Moderator on `/admin/settings` (interim, extends ADR-0025).** The page-level `notFound()` (02 RP-04) streams under `app/admin/loading.tsx` + `app/admin/settings/loading.tsx`, so a signed-in moderator receives the root 404 body (no shell, no settings content) with HTTP status 200 — the same Next streaming behaviour ADR-0025 accepted for unknown ISR slugs. 05 T-E2E-33 asserts the body and status ∈ {200, 404}; role `user` on every `/admin/*` stays a real 404 (layout-level). A true 404 would need the moderator check in the admin layout, which has no pathname — revisit with ADR-0025.
18. **COV-4 is read on the combined run.** `lib/jobs/**` and `lib/notify/**` thresholds (85 / 80) apply only to an unfiltered `vitest run --coverage` (`pnpm test:coverage`); CI-3 runs that command instead of `pnpm test:db --coverage` (COV-2 still enforced there). Reason: the pure notify modules (`matrix.ts`, `constants.ts`, the deliverer builders behind T-ADP-19) are unit-covered and the jobs/deliverers db-covered — either lane alone under-reads the scope.
19. **Settings page as built.** `NotificationMatrix` renders a `<div>` of sections with React state and only the SAVE strip as a `<form action>` (the Moderators `children` slot carries server `<form>`s — forms cannot nest; one `updateSettings` call still saves everything, SAVE disabled until dirty); every non-ok Test line is prefixed `✕ `; `Chip` gains the additive `removeLabel?: string` so the admin-email chips announce "Remove <email>"; copy follows the pass-3 prototype where DESIGN.md/03 are silent: page lead "Moderation, notifications, mods, Ko-fi. That's all of it.", moderation consequence lines "Their first comment waits for you. Everything after posts straight away." / "Everything posts immediately. You clean up after.", NOTIFICATIONS lead "Site-level. One grid for all admins, two channels. The allay picks events up and delivers them — everything sends as allay@odsens.com.", webhook helper "Masked after save.", add-email field "Add an admin email" with placeholder "Type an address, press enter" and helper "Only what's typed here. Google emails are never reused silently.", Moderators columns Handle · Role · Actions with role words Admin / Mod, own row "That's you" (no Remove), add form "Add by handle" + "Add mod", Ko-fi "Page name" (prefix `ko-fi.com/`, helper "Tips land in Ko-fi. We only link out.") + Webhook NOT SET + "Arrives with Phase 2.", footer "SAVE SETTINGS" + "Saves everything on this page."; the mail word for a source with no ok run is "No good run yet." (in place of the stale lead line; the `Last run / Last good run <runAt>.` meta line is omitted when there is no run to name) and the Discord line is "<Source> counts haven't updated yet." — the word "never" appears in neither (`EventContent.runAt = ''` means "no such run"); COMING LATER is a plain `PixelLabel tone="mute-dim" size={11}` beside the row label (not the pass-3 frame's neutral-fill tag — `PixelLabel fill="neutral"` would paint it chalk-on-wash), the row's `<th>` words and phone micro-labels sit at 45 % opacity and the disabled `Toggle` dims itself; the ✔ Test line renders in `--emerald-soft` and the ✕ line in `--danger`; the Test line's `validation` words follow the first-issue rule (04 SC-03): a URL outside the §1.3 regex reads `✕ That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL.`, nothing typed and nothing stored reads `✕ Add a webhook URL first.`; the webhook `Field type=password` carries `autoComplete="new-password"` so no password manager offers to save it (01 INV-43); `Toggle` gains the additive `describedBy?: string` (`aria-describedby` on the input) and the three moderation consequence lines carry ids the radios/switch point at (03 C-03) (design gate may rename any of these — one string each).

20. **Gate round 1 letter (2026-09-03, `spec-drift-reviewer`).** (a) The `/admin/projects` heading-row secondary `Button` "New exclusive project" → `/admin/projects/new` is the list's one entry point to the S1.3 create form; it rides this PR (built in a parallel session) and 02 §1.3's `/admin/projects` Components cell + 05 T-E2E-35's opening leg now name it. (b) `@react-email/ui` (dev) is listed in 01 INV-78 as the `pnpm email dev` companion (D15 relied on the `react-email` allowance without amending the row). (c) 01 §1's folder tree names `lib/jobs/runner.ts`, `lib/jobs/notify.ts` (D1/D2) and `lib/notify/deliver/{content,types}.ts`. (d) `backend-reviewer` advisory applied: `DELIVER_TIME_BUDGET_MS` 40000 → 12000 (04 §5.8 tunable — the 40 s budget plus one ~47 s worst-case SC-09 send overran the route's 60 s `maxDuration`, which could kill a unit before its N4 mark and park the SC-13 lock for 15 min). (e) `frontend-reviewer` advisory applied: the MODERATORS section no longer duplicates the `Table` region name (axe `landmark-unique`).

## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| Keep hand-rolled lock/insert/finalize in each job and copy the J-F block | Four jobs to come; 00 §S1.5 names a shared runner as the mechanism. |
| Change `notification_events.subject_id` to `text` | A type change on a live S1.4 table for one event kind; every comment event stores a uuid anyway. |
| Emit `sync.stale` for `youtube` from the S1.5 merge | Mails admins every 6 h about a job that does not exist yet. |
| Delete a user's events at `deleteAccount` | `comment.reported` events are the moderators' audit trail, not the user's data; scrubbing the reference keeps both promises. |
| A second client island (`SettingsForm`) or making the Moderators table client-side | A new `'use client'` file needs a C-16a row + ADR; server forms + PRG already cover row actions (ADR-0024). |
| `resend` npm SDK | Base URL not injectable → no fixture server, no H-5 mocking; the wire shape is one POST. |
| Inline the digest in `deliver/email.ts` | Untestable in `pnpm email dev`; T-UNIT-3 wants "digest via `EmailLayout`" rendered like the others. |
| Treat Discord `retry_after` as seconds | Contradicts 04 §4.6 / T-ADP-18 as frozen; the retry-once path fails safe either way (row error → 5-min backoff). |
| Cap `updateSettings.matrix` at 10 entries | Stricter than the frozen 04 §1.3 input; `matrixDiff` sends ≤ 10 and the server-action body limit bounds the rest — flagged for the security gate rather than changed. |

## Consequences
- Positive: one runner, one orchestrator, one client island; `sync.stale` cannot spam; account deletion scrubs the event log; every adapter stays mockable.
- Negative: `syncModrinth`/`syncCurseforge` are refactored (their tests must stay green byte-for-byte on behaviour); the registry gains `runner.ts`, `notify.ts`, `format/secret.ts`, `Digest`; two fixture-server routes are POST.
- Follow-ups: S1.6 appends `youtube` behaviour untouched (D3 already covers it once runs exist); S1.8 wires the `mentions` F0 condition → `backend-robustness`; Discord `retry_after` units → questions.md follow-up; `@react-email/components` is flagged deprecated on npm (its sub-packages are current) — `upkeep` may move to `react-email`'s runtime exports with an INV-78 ADR.
